sloka: तथा ऽहं हरिसैन्यस्य सागरं प्रेक्ष्य सीदतः ।व्यवधूय भयं ताव्रं योजनानां शतं प्लुतः ।। ५.३५.७०।।।।
transliteration: tathā 'haṁ harisainyasya sāgaraṁ prekṣya sīdataḥ ।vyavadhūya bhayaṁ tāvraṁ yojanānāṁ śataṁ plutaḥ ।। 5.35.70।।।।

translations.english: "When the vanara army was feeling despondent at the sight of the ocean, I leaped across the sea, a hundred yojanas, pushing aside all my fear.
